scripts.update-version: node -e "import fs from 'fs'; const v = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('../extension/package.json')).version; const f = '../../famiprog-vscode-forgejo-gh-pages/index.html'; const i = fs.readFileSync(f).toString(); fs.writeFileSync(f, i.replace(/v(\d.*?)<\/code>/g, 'v' + v + ''))"
scripts.gh-pages: yarn package-web && yarn update-version && dest=../../famiprog-vscode-forgejo-gh-pages/vscode-web-public; rm -rf "$dest" && mkdir -p "$dest/node_modules" "$dest/famiprog-vscode-forgejo" && cp index.html "$dest/" && cp customizeBootOptions.js "$dest/" && cp -a node_modules/@github1s "$dest/node_modules/" && cp -aL famiprog-vscode-forgejo/package.json famiprog-vscode-forgejo/dist "$dest/famiprog-vscode-forgejo/"
